name: linux-screen-share
description: Share your Linux screen to any TV or phone browser with one click.

scripts.start: bun run resources && vite build && electrobun dev
scripts.dev: bun run resources && vite build && electrobun dev --watch
scripts.dev:live: bun run resources && vite build && concurrently -k "vite build --watch" "electrobun dev --watch"
scripts.build: bun run resources && vite build && electrobun build
scripts.package: bun run resources && vite build && electrobun build --env=stable && bun scripts/package-appimage.mjs
